bindings.note: Source-declared relationship target; missing targets remain exceptions, not fabricated organizations.

concepts.description: An organization represented by ROR. This is a source-local organization role; it does not establish legal entity or LEI equivalence. All source statuses are retained. Native identifier URLs are byte-exact source keys.

bindings.note: Accepted source-public reference; independent GeoNames closure report retains absent upstream targets.

concepts.description: Source-declared locations.geonames_id in the GeoNames geonameid namespace. Many organization locations can reference zero or one feature each; an organization may have multiple locations. This does not classify every feature as a city or establish a user geocoder. Retain nulls and ordinals.

document.description: Full ROR schema 2 records with native URL identity and all statuses. Locations and relationships are ordered physical projections of their source arrays, not extra logical public recordsets. Source bindings do not authorize any user identifier mapping or name-to-identity matching.
document.name: Research Organization Registry source projection
